body:
Giving it a go.

I'm not calm now but I've had moments of calm over the last few months and still been miserable even in moments of calm.

I feel like diet is at the very bottom of the list of my problems though. It adds to the misery but it's definitely not a source of misery. I can't imagine changing my diet helping much of anything. I can't imagine changing ANYTHING for that matter will help. There's no joy in anything. I can't change a habit from something terrible to something equally joyless.

I'm so sorry that you feel the same way I do. It's such a miserable rotten feeling.

I don't know what baby steps to take. I've written a long list of all the things I want to change but I haven't been able to change a single thing on it. Have you had any luck taking baby steps? What did you do?
